title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content: 回到自己的屋内，小夜迫不及待的打开《冲灵诀》一字一句的看起来，嗯，大部分都认识，就是字语连起来，就不知道是啥意思了，还有，这个脉，穴，胫…这个，这咋找？有图，也找不准啊？小夜摸了摸自己的小肚子，“丹田？”“屁股下就叫会阴？”“檀中是这里吗？怎么有点麻？这么盘腿对不对啊？十二脉…哦，这里，脊柱大龙”“少阳…”“这么呼吸能把人憋死，舌头弯了，顶上颚？咦！刚刚摸着疼的穴叫啥来着，”“算了，赶明儿个到镇子上的镖局里找旺财哥，问问他。再去到镇上医堂问问秦先生，这个穴啊，脉啊，筋啊有啥讲究和作用，对，就这么办，还要向管家要些银两！”小夜没啥纠结的，盘腿坐在床上，按照书上的内容呼吸吐纳，不一会儿，就口干舌燥，腰酸背痛，浑身难受。起床来去茅厕小解一下，又在院子里耍了一通王八拳，就回到屋内，又开始打坐练功，难受啊！又去茅厕小解，回屋打坐，如此三番五次，困了，就倒头大睡。第二天，太阳晒屁股的时候，仆人几次三番把小夜拽起来，侍奉小主人洗漱，就餐后，就不管他了。仆人也忙，还要打理花花草草，还要下地干活，去镇上购物等等，杂七杂八的事不少。老爷从不打骂仆人，做错了事，直接领钱卷铺盖滚蛋，根本就没有下不为例这一说。所以，仆人们每天都是战战兢兢，如履薄冰，没办法，薪酬高啊！记得有一次，舅舅因为一件事不满解雇了刘婶，小夜找舅舅说情，路真人看了看他，冷冷的说道“你记住，机会往往只有一次，抓住抓不住，是你自己的事，机会失去了，你才会珍惜，但是，迟了。等你长大了，你就会深深地觉得，如果有那么一次机会是多么大的奢侈，有人等一辈子都不会有那么一丁点儿的机会，不珍惜眼前，不珍惜当下，你呀，悔一生。”“舅舅，问题是刘婶儿子发烧，她心里难受，着急，你不能原谅她一次吗？”“哼，她完全可以不错的，孩子病不是在我这里犯错的理由，”自此以后，仆人们没有一个做错事的，此事也给小夜留下深深的印象。吃罢饭，小夜轻手轻脚的去舅舅房间外偷听了一下，就回到自己房间，翻开《修真杂记》，哇！这本书可比那什么《太上冲灵诀》好看多了，也容易记会。“原来灵根是这么回事，怎么这么多种灵根？阴煞灵根、玄阳灵根是个啥东西？凝气九层后面是筑基，筑基后才能驭器飞行啊，再往后金丹，呵呵，舅舅说他就是金丹修士，金丹期就能活五百年？天啊！还有，碎丹成婴，元婴修士能活三千多年。三千岁！三千岁！那是啥概念啊，如果吃一些延年益寿的药物就能活四千年。化婴，咋化？还要渡雷劫，什么？丹田肚子里有个和自己一模一样的小人？那不成了孕妇了吗？不会生孩子吧？哈哈哈，有意思”小夜看着书籍很好奇，很向往。“元婴后面，还有化神？化神真人就活两万岁，化了神就可以飞到灵界去修行，先炼虚，再合体也叫合和，然后是大乘，大乘度过劫就变成神仙了？嘿嘿，容易，小意思。嗯？大乘如果不能飞升，过个几千年就要造雷劈，活活劈死啊！…”内容很精彩，深深地吸引着小夜，中午，仆人送饭时，小夜都没有觉察。“大玉姐，一会儿，大壮，二牛他们来叫我玩，你说我忙着呢，就说舅舅让我练字，不玩去了。”小夜对佣人说道。“知道了，小少爷！赶紧吃饭吧！”吃过饭，一个下午，小夜都在聚精会神的看书，内容太多太多了，很丰富，炼体，剑修，秘境，灵药，仙草，灵石，等等。不知不觉，晚饭到了，小夜吃饭一直是细嚼慢咽，这是舅舅教的。饭后，小夜去了舅舅书房，叩门后，里面传来声音“进来吧！”“看完了？”“嗯，没看完，太多，舅舅，我要修仙，我不怕苦，不怕累，一定要修，”小夜拿出几页纸，这都是他看不懂的，记录下来，准备请教青焰散人的。路真人一招手，几页纸就到了他手里，反正也说开了，自己就是修士，是修仙者，真人也不藏着掖着了，就露了一手。小夜看的一惊一乍。“不错，记下的问题很详细，我给你讲讲。”接下来，路真人细心地给外甥一一讲解，描述。同时拿出来个小假人，小人身上画满了线条，布满了小点，五颜六色。“这个木偶身体上，就是你要记住的脉，穴，筋，络，这些是最基本的，必须牢记，也没有捷径，靠死记硬背，夜儿啊，知道舅舅为什么每日饮食很少吗？”“知道，是辟谷吧？”小夜在书上看到过，知道筑基后，就能很长时间不吃不喝也饿不死。“我每天吃一点，是给仆人们看的，吃完饭我还要偷偷的炼化掉，修士吞吐天地之灵气，不食凡物，以免筋络堵塞，通俗的讲，修士胃很小，而且，肠子很短，就直直的一条，为的就是给丹田，紫府腾出地方，以便将来金丹，元婴有地方住。你到凝气4层时，身体就会排出来脓血，那就是体内杂质和许些没用的器官化脓后排出。”“下面我讲讲修真百艺，从大的方面说，就分4类，炼丹，炼器，阵法，符箓，从小的方面说就多了，灵植，酿酒，食材，御兽，提纯等等，你将来如果能走上修真路，必须掌握一到两门技艺，多了可不行，影响修行，记住啊，修行才是根本，每个人时间有限，生命有限，精力有限，体力有限，不可能百事百通，境界第一，低级修士永远不可能炼出高级丹药来，我观你是有土，火，木灵根，水，金灵根微弱难查，你应该是个三灵根，资质一般般，我双灵根，修道三百载，不过区区金丹修士，就这也超过近九成人了，乐观一点，你这辈子没有大机遇，大造化，就是个金丹修士，如果稍有松懈，你难以筑基，60岁前不筑基，你就死了心吧，这辈子娶几房娇娘，去世俗界当个福家翁吧，运气好生个有灵根的儿孙，寄托儿孙实现你的修仙梦想。嘿嘿，你托生在了个好家族啊，起码前期修炼不用发愁资源，虽然大家族里尔诈我虞，蝇营狗苟，但是还是比我们这些小宗门，或者是散修强上不少，所以，知足吧，什么是你的？什么是我的？资源面前，无人相让，大道面前，步步相争。哼哼，利益面前，兄弟相残，父子反目，夫妻算计，这些比比皆是…法财侣地缺一不可，侣不是单单的道侣，可以是师尊，真正的道友…”路真人也是有感而发，仿佛以前的经历都在眼前，说着说着就跑调了。说了良久，青焰舅舅才讪讪一笑，觉得不太对题，终于喝了口茶，清了清嗓音道“夜儿啊，我观你酷爱绘画，自七岁时就爱不释手，画的有模有样，不要丢下这个爱好，说不定将来有制符的天赋。好了，你去吧，这段时间就先慢慢练手，啥时候找到气感了，能引气入体了，啥时候再来找我，我感觉瓶颈松动，去后堂闭关几个月，下人们问起，就说我出趟远门了，无事不要打扰我，一切如旧，按部就班。”“哦，外甥告退。”小夜行礼退出。
content_en: Back in her room, Xiao Ye couldn't wait to open "Chong Ling Jue" and looked at it word by word. Well, she knew most of them, but when the words were connected, she didn't know what they meant. Also, this pulse, acupoint, shin... this, how do you find it?There is a picture, but I can’t find it?Xiaoye touched her belly, "Dantian?" "The area under the butt is called the perineum?" "Is this here in Tanzhong? Why is it a little numb? Is it right to cross your legs like this? Twelve meridians...oh, here, the spine dragon" "Shaoyang..." "Such a breath can suffocate a person to death, with the tongue bent and pressed against the roof of the mouth? Hey! What did you call the painful point you just touched?" "Forget it, I'll be there tomorrow.Go to Brother Wangcai at the escort agency in the town and ask him.Then go to the medical hall in town and ask Mr. Qin what the points, pulses, and tendons are about. Yes, that’s it, and you have to ask the housekeeper for some silver coins!”Xiaoye didn’t have any worries. She sat cross-legged on the bed and breathed according to the content in the book. After a while, her mouth became dry, her waist and back hurt, and her whole body felt uncomfortable.I got up and went to the toilet to relieve myself, and then performed a round of boxing in the yard. Then I returned to the house and started meditating again. It was so uncomfortable!Then he went to the toilet to relieve himself, then returned to the house to meditate. He did this again and again, and when he felt sleepy, he fell asleep.The next day, when the sun was shining, the servants pulled Xiaoye up several times and helped the young master wash up. After the meal, they ignored him.The servants are also busy. They have to take care of the flowers and plants, work in the fields, go shopping in the town, etc. There are many miscellaneous things.The master never beats or scolds his servants. If he does something wrong, he just collects the money, packs up the bed, and gets out. There is no such thing as an exception.Therefore, the servants are trembling and walking on thin ice every day. They have no choice but to pay well!I remember one time, my uncle fired Aunt Liu because he was dissatisfied with something. Xiaoye went to his uncle to intercede. Mr. Lu looked at him and said coldly, "Remember, there is often only one opportunity. Whether you can seize it or not is your own business. You will only cherish the opportunity if it is lost, but it is too late. When you grow up, you will deeply feel that it is such a luxury to have such an opportunity. Some people wait for a lifetime.If you don't cherish the present moment, you will regret it for the rest of your life.""Uncle, the problem is that Aunt Liu's son has a fever, and she feels uncomfortable and anxious.Can't you forgive her once?" "Humph, she can definitely do well. The child's illness is not the reason for making mistakes here." From then on, none of the servants did anything wrong, and this incident also left a deep impression on Xiaoye.After eating, Xiaoye quietly went to eavesdrop outside her uncle's room, then returned to her room and opened "Miscellaneous Notes on Cultivation", wow!This book is much better to read than that "Tai Shang Chong Ling Jue", and it is also easy to memorize."So this is what spiritual roots are, why are there so many kinds of spiritual roots? What are the Yin Evil Spiritual Roots and the Xuanyang Spiritual Roots? Behind the ninth layer of Qi Condensation is the foundation. Only after the foundation is established can you control the aircraft and fly. After that, the golden elixir. Haha, my uncle said that he is a golden elixir monk. He can live for five hundred years in the golden elixir period? Oh my God! Also, after breaking the elixir into an infant, a Nascent Soul monk can live for more than three thousand years.Three thousand years!Three thousand years!What is the concept?If you can live for four thousand years by taking some life-prolonging medicine, why?There is a little person in the belly that is exactly the same as yourself?Hahaha, it's interesting.""Behind the Nascent Soul, there is the Transformation God? The Transformation God will live for 20,000 years. After transforming into a god, he can fly to the spirit world to practice. He will first practice the void and then merge into a body, which is also called Hehe. Then the Mahayana. After the Mahayana tribulation, he will become a god? Hehe, it's easy. It's trivial. Huh? If the Mahayana cannot ascend, in a few thousand years it will be struck by thunder and killed alive!..." The content was very exciting and deeply attracted Xiaoye. At noon, Xiaoye didn't even notice when the servant delivered the meal."Sister Dayu, after a while, Da Zhuang, Er Niu and others came to ask me to play. If you said I was busy, just say that my uncle asked me to practice calligraphy and stop playing." Xiaoye said to the servant."I understand, young master! Hurry up and eat!" After dinner, Xiaoye spent the entire afternoon reading attentively. There was too much content, very rich, including body training, sword cultivation, secret realms, elixirs, fairy grass, spiritual stones, etc.Unknowingly, dinner arrived, and Xiaoye always chewed her food carefully, as her uncle taught her.After dinner, Xiaoye went to her uncle's study. After knocking on the door, a voice came from inside, "Come in!" "Have you finished reading?" "Well, I haven't finished reading. It's too much. Uncle, I want to cultivate immortality. I'm not afraid of hardship or tiredness. I must cultivate." Xiaoye took out a few pages, which he couldn't understand. He wrote them down and prepared to ask Qingyan Sanren for advice.Master Lu waved and a few pages of paper came into his hand. Anyway, he said that he was a monk and a cultivator of immortality. Master Lu didn't hide it and just revealed it.Xiaoye was shocked when she saw it."That's right. The questions I wrote down are very detailed. I'll explain them to you." Next, Master Lu carefully explained and described them to his nephew one by one.At the same time, he took out a small dummy, which was covered with lines and dots in various colors."On the body of this puppet, you have to remember the pulses, points, tendons, and collaterals. These are the most basic ones. You must remember them. There are no shortcuts. You have to memorize them by rote. Ye'er, do you know why your uncle eats so little every day?" "You know, it's inedia, right?" Xiao Ye has read it in a book and knows that after building the foundation, you can go without eating or drinking for a long time without starving to death."I eat a little every day for the servants to see. After eating, I have to secretly refine it. Monks swallow the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and do not eat ordinary food to avoid clogging of muscles and joints. Generally speaking, monks have small stomachs and short intestines, which are straight, in order to supply the Dantian., Zifu will make room so that Jindan and Nascent Soul can have a place to live in the future.When you reach the fourth level of Qi Condensation, your body will discharge pus and blood, which is the impurities and useless organs in the body that will be discharged after suppuration., alchemy, weapon refining, formations, talismans, in small aspects, there are many, spiritual plants, wine making, food ingredients, beast control, purification, etc. If you can embark on the path of cultivation in the future, you must master one or two skills. Too many will not be enough, and it will affect your cultivation. Remember, cultivation is the foundation., everyone has limited time, limited life, limited energy, limited physical strength, it is impossible to know everything, and the realm is first. Low-level monks can never refine high-level elixirs. I think you have earth, fire, wood spiritual roots, water, and golden spiritual roots. They are weak and difficult to detect. You should be a three-spirit.My roots and qualifications are average. I have two spiritual roots and have practiced Taoism for three hundred years. However, I am a mere Golden elixir monk, which is more than nearly 90%. Be optimistic. You will not have big opportunities in this life. Great fortune, just a Golden elixir monk. If you relax a little, it will be difficult for you to build the foundation. You will not be able to build a foundation before the age of 60.Build the foundation, just give up, marry a few beautiful wives in this life, go to the secular world and be a wealthy man. If you are lucky, you will have children and grandchildren with spiritual roots, and you can rely on your children and grandchildren to realize your dream of cultivating immortals.Hey, you were born into a good family. At least you don’t have to worry about resources in the early stage of cultivation.The big family is a fool, but it is still much better than small sects like us, or casual cultivators, so be content, what is yours?What is mine?In the face of resources, no one gives in, and in the face of the road, we fight every step of the way.Brothers fighting each other, fathers and sons turning against each other, husbands and wives scheming, these are everywhere... Dharma and wealth lovers are indispensable. The couple is not just a Taoist couple, they can be a master, a true Taoist friend..." Master Lu also spoke with emotion, as if all his previous experiences were before his eyes, and he was out of tune as he spoke.After talking for a long time, Uncle Qingyan smiled and felt that something was not right. He finally took a sip of tea, cleared his voice and said, "Ye'er, I see you love painting. You have been fond of painting since you were seven years old. You can paint in a decent way. Don't give up this hobby. Maybe you will have the talent to make talismans in the future. Okay, go ahead, during this timeJust practice slowly first. When you find the sense of Qi and can draw Qi into the body, you can come back to me. I feel that the bottleneck has loosened. I went to the back hall to retreat for a few months. When the servants asked, they said that I was going on a long trip.Don't disturb me if you have nothing to do.Everything is as usual, step by step." "Oh, my nephew bowed out."
title_en: Recommended popular novels that have been completed
content_zh: 回到自己的屋内，小夜迫不及待的打开《冲灵诀》一字一句的看起来，嗯，大部分都认识，就是字语连起来，就不知道是啥意思了，还有，这个脉，穴，胫…这个，这咋找？有图，也找不准啊？小夜摸了摸自己的小肚子，“丹田？”“屁股下就叫会阴？”“檀中是这里吗？怎么有点麻？这么盘腿对不对啊？十二脉…哦，这里，脊柱大龙”“少阳…”“这么呼吸能把人憋死，舌头弯了，顶上颚？咦！刚刚摸着疼的穴叫啥来着，”“算了，赶明儿个到镇子上的镖局里找旺财哥，问问他。再去到镇上医堂问问秦先生，这个穴啊，脉啊，筋啊有啥讲究和作用，对，就这么办，还要向管家要些银两！”小夜没啥纠结的，盘腿坐在床上，按照书上的内容呼吸吐纳，不一会儿，就口干舌燥，腰酸背痛，浑身难受。起床来去茅厕小解一下，又在院子里耍了一通王八拳，就回到屋内，又开始打坐练功，难受啊！又去茅厕小解，回屋打坐，如此三番五次，困了，就倒头大睡。第二天，太阳晒屁股的时候，仆人几次三番把小夜拽起来，侍奉小主人洗漱，就餐后，就不管他了。仆人也忙，还要打理花花草草，还要下地干活，去镇上购物等等，杂七杂八的事不少。老爷从不打骂仆人，做错了事，直接领钱卷铺盖滚蛋，根本就没有下不为例这一说。所以，仆人们每天都是战战兢兢，如履薄冰，没办法，薪酬高啊！记得有一次，舅舅因为一件事不满解雇了刘婶，小夜找舅舅说情，路真人看了看他，冷冷的说道“你记住，机会往往只有一次，抓住抓不住，是你自己的事，机会失去了，你才会珍惜，但是，迟了。等你长大了，你就会深深地觉得，如果有那么一次机会是多么大的奢侈，有人等一辈子都不会有那么一丁点儿的机会，不珍惜眼前，不珍惜当下，你呀，悔一生。”“舅舅，问题是刘婶儿子发烧，她心里难受，着急，你不能原谅她一次吗？”“哼，她完全可以不错的，孩子病不是在我这里犯错的理由，”自此以后，仆人们没有一个做错事的，此事也给小夜留下深深的印象。吃罢饭，小夜轻手轻脚的去舅舅房间外偷听了一下，就回到自己房间，翻开《修真杂记》，哇！这本书可比那什么《太上冲灵诀》好看多了，也容易记会。“原来灵根是这么回事，怎么这么多种灵根？阴煞灵根、玄阳灵根是个啥东西？凝气九层后面是筑基，筑基后才能驭器飞行啊，再往后金丹，呵呵，舅舅说他就是金丹修士，金丹期就能活五百年？天啊！还有，碎丹成婴，元婴修士能活三千多年。三千岁！三千岁！那是啥概念啊，如果吃一些延年益寿的药物就能活四千年。化婴，咋化？还要渡雷劫，什么？丹田肚子里有个和自己一模一样的小人？那不成了孕妇了吗？不会生孩子吧？哈哈哈，有意思”小夜看着书籍很好奇，很向往。“元婴后面，还有化神？化神真人就活两万岁，化了神就可以飞到灵界去修行，先炼虚，再合体也叫合和，然后是大乘，大乘度过劫就变成神仙了？嘿嘿，容易，小意思。嗯？大乘如果不能飞升，过个几千年就要造雷劈，活活劈死啊！…”内容很精彩，深深地吸引着小夜，中午，仆人送饭时，小夜都没有觉察。“大玉姐，一会儿，大壮，二牛他们来叫我玩，你说我忙着呢，就说舅舅让我练字，不玩去了。”小夜对佣人说道。“知道了，小少爷！赶紧吃饭吧！”吃过饭，一个下午，小夜都在聚精会神的看书，内容太多太多了，很丰富，炼体，剑修，秘境，灵药，仙草，灵石，等等。不知不觉，晚饭到了，小夜吃饭一直是细嚼慢咽，这是舅舅教的。饭后，小夜去了舅舅书房，叩门后，里面传来声音“进来吧！”“看完了？”“嗯，没看完，太多，舅舅，我要修仙，我不怕苦，不怕累，一定要修，”小夜拿出几页纸，这都是他看不懂的，记录下来，准备请教青焰散人的。路真人一招手，几页纸就到了他手里，反正也说开了，自己就是修士，是修仙者，真人也不藏着掖着了，就露了一手。小夜看的一惊一乍。“不错，记下的问题很详细，我给你讲讲。”接下来，路真人细心地给外甥一一讲解，描述。同时拿出来个小假人，小人身上画满了线条，布满了小点，五颜六色。“这个木偶身体上，就是你要记住的脉，穴，筋，络，这些是最基本的，必须牢记，也没有捷径，靠死记硬背，夜儿啊，知道舅舅为什么每日饮食很少吗？”“知道，是辟谷吧？”小夜在书上看到过，知道筑基后，就能很长时间不吃不喝也饿不死。“我每天吃一点，是给仆人们看的，吃完饭我还要偷偷的炼化掉，修士吞吐天地之灵气，不食凡物，以免筋络堵塞，通俗的讲，修士胃很小，而且，肠子很短，就直直的一条，为的就是给丹田，紫府腾出地方，以便将来金丹，元婴有地方住。你到凝气4层时，身体就会排出来脓血，那就是体内杂质和许些没用的器官化脓后排出。”“下面我讲讲修真百艺，从大的方面说，就分4类，炼丹，炼器，阵法，符箓，从小的方面说就多了，灵植，酿酒，食材，御兽，提纯等等，你将来如果能走上修真路，必须掌握一到两门技艺，多了可不行，影响修行，记住啊，修行才是根本，每个人时间有限，生命有限，精力有限，体力有限，不可能百事百通，境界第一，低级修士永远不可能炼出高级丹药来，我观你是有土，火，木灵根，水，金灵根微弱难查，你应该是个三灵根，资质一般般，我双灵根，修道三百载，不过区区金丹修士，就这也超过近九成人了，乐观一点，你这辈子没有大机遇，大造化，就是个金丹修士，如果稍有松懈，你难以筑基，60岁前不筑基，你就死了心吧，这辈子娶几房娇娘，去世俗界当个福家翁吧，运气好生个有灵根的儿孙，寄托儿孙实现你的修仙梦想。嘿嘿，你托生在了个好家族啊，起码前期修炼不用发愁资源，虽然大家族里尔诈我虞，蝇营狗苟，但是还是比我们这些小宗门，或者是散修强上不少，所以，知足吧，什么是你的？什么是我的？资源面前，无人相让，大道面前，步步相争。哼哼，利益面前，兄弟相残，父子反目，夫妻算计，这些比比皆是…法财侣地缺一不可，侣不是单单的道侣，可以是师尊，真正的道友…”路真人也是有感而发，仿佛以前的经历都在眼前，说着说着就跑调了。说了良久，青焰舅舅才讪讪一笑，觉得不太对题，终于喝了口茶，清了清嗓音道“夜儿啊，我观你酷爱绘画，自七岁时就爱不释手，画的有模有样，不要丢下这个爱好，说不定将来有制符的天赋。好了，你去吧，这段时间就先慢慢练手，啥时候找到气感了，能引气入体了，啥时候再来找我，我感觉瓶颈松动，去后堂闭关几个月，下人们问起，就说我出趟远门了，无事不要打扰我，一切如旧，按部就班。”“哦，外甥告退。”小夜行礼退出。
